desert_terrain.description: a different area of operations: warm, bright, low-contrast ground with less fine structure

different_sensor.description: a different imaging chain: softer optics, column-correlated fixed-pattern noise, different spectral response

identical.description: the same collection conditions on both sides

low_illumination.description: dusk/night collection: lower exposure, compressed contrast, visible read noise

winter_season.description: winter collection: snow cover, low solar angle, desaturated and colder ground

note: every transform here is a LEGITIMATE collection condition. The lab's purpose is to establish that the system observes them without classifying them as attacks.

reference_context.source: lab baseline declaration; synthetic, and a claim like any other
